facts.text: The clone lists SMC100 as a single-axis motion controller
SMC100 is the class for a controller device for positioners and works over USB
Every command is prefixed with the controller's device number before it is written
A query is prefixed with the device number and the first three characters of the reply are stripped
move_abs sends PA followed by the position, which is in the stage's units
move_rel sends PR followed by the distance, which is in the stage's units
home sends PA0 and moves the device to position 0
homing sends OR and works only when the controller state is NOT REFERENCED
stop sends ST to stop motion
reset sends RS and leaves the controller in NOT REFERENCED state
enable sends MM1 (READY) and disable sends MM0 (DISABLE)
position queries PA? and returns the reply as a float
speed queries VA? and is set with VA followed by the value
acceleration queries AC? and is set with AC followed by the value
is_moving reads the controller status with TS and compares it with 0x28
get_last_command_error queries TE and clears the controller's error buffer
The upstream plugin was tested with an SMC100PP controller and a URS150 rotation stage
The PyMoDAQ move plugin sets the controller unit to degrees for its URS150 stage and says the unit should be changed for linear actuators
The PyMoDAQ move plugin sets _controller_units to the degree sign for its SMC100 stage
